description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ranawana, Harispatthuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320324
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for specific parcels in Kandy District. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, owners' details, extent of land, and title classifications, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
